source_note: 随机变量期望收敛导出几乎处处收敛的一个条件
english_source_note: A Condition Turning Mean Convergence into Almost Sure Convergence
callout_id: 随机变量期望收敛导出几乎处处收敛的一个条件#4
statement_en: Let $f_n$ be a sequence of measurable functions on a measure space $(X, \mathcal{F}, \mu)$. Write $E_{\mu}(f_n)=\int_X f_n\,d\mu$ and $V_{\mu}(f_n)=\int_X (f_n-E_{\mu}f_n)^2\,d\mu$. If $$E_{\mu}(f_n) \to C$$ and $$\sum_{n\geq 1} V_{\mu}(f_n) < \infty,$$ then $f_n \to C$ almost everywhere on $X$.
callout_body: $f_n$是测度空间$(X,\mathcal{F},\mu)$上的一列可测函数列，记$E_{\mu}(f_n)=\int_X f_n\,d\mu$，$V_{\mu}(f_n)=\int_X (f_n-E_{\mu}f_n)^2\,d\mu$那么如果$$E_{\mu}(f_n)\to C$$并且$$\sum_{n\geq 1}V_{\mu}(f_n)<\infty$$那么$f_n\to C$在$X$上几乎处处成立。
